messages.author: bea0a325f13d3b53
messages.subject: Cell labels for mosaic plots
parts:
Can anyone tell me how I can enter cell labels into the tiles of a
mosaic plot (percentages of y-axis and raw figures). Many thanks,
Marco

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Cell labels for mosaic plots
parts:
Well, that function plots the tiles into coordinate system from
APPROXIMATELY 0 to 1 so you can use the proportions from the table to
get things ROUGHLY into the middles of tiles, but it's not great.
mosaic ({vcd}) is even worse in that regard. locator() might be your
best choice, but of course it's only interactive and approximate, too.

STG

I was trying to figure out a way to get the height of the tile displayed on the tile, i.e. the proportion of 1 in the coordinate system.
